description: Header file for SDSLib 2.0, a C dynamic strings library, defining string structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing dynamic strings.

methods.name: sdslen
methods.description: Returns the length of the dynamic string.

methods.name: sdsavail
methods.description: Returns the available space in the dynamic string.

methods.name: sdssetlen
methods.description: Sets the length of the dynamic string.

methods.name: sdsinclen
methods.description: Increments the length of the dynamic string.

methods.name: sdsalloc
methods.description: Returns the total allocated size of the dynamic string.

methods.name: sdssetalloc
methods.description: Sets the allocated size of the dynamic string.
